title: VTDiag scan snapshot
description: One full PC scan: three-valued facts (known / unknown with reason / notApplicable) grouped in sections. Unknown is never False.

appVersion.description: App version that produced the snapshot (SemVer).

kbVersion.description: KB version that supplied pack collectors (CalVer).

privilege.description: Elevated or limited engine. In limited mode admin-only facts are Unknown(NeedsAdmin).

kind.description: Boot kind (Kernel-Boot event 27 boot type when available).

value.description: Identifies one boot of Windows. Used to tell "my reboot happened" from "the user chose Shut down with Fast Startup" and from "Windows Update rebooted the PC" (DESIGN.md section 2, reboot-resume).

machineKey.description: HMAC of stable hardware ids with a per-install salt that is never exported. Lets a helper tell that two reports come from the same PC without learning any serial.

items.description: Per-collector run record.

runs.description: One entry per collector: status, time, issue codes. The report's "what we couldn't read and why".
